demo.step.title.title: ITZA SPACE: See Earth Through Time
demo.step.fieldMemory.title: The field remembers
demo.step.fieldMemory.note: It found the field's history from NASA satellites, including the bare months.
demo.step.climate.title: Every season compared
demo.step.climate.note: The worst season on record is flagged automatically, from the data, not a guess.
demo.step.replay.title: Replay the past
demo.step.replay.note: Three rotations replay the worst season. Soil water drains fastest under the current one.
demo.step.assistant.title: Ask, and see the answer
demo.step.assistant.note: The assistant doesn't just talk: it builds the answer from real tool calls, and every number carries its source.
demo.step.sliders.title: Options, not orders
demo.step.sliders.note: Rainfall −20%: the ranking shifts, and the most robust rotation stands out.
demo.step.future.title: Fly into 2050
demo.step.future.note: The same rotations, replayed under NASA climate projections.
demo.step.validation.title: Same dilemma, two continents
demo.step.arena.title: Three methods, one answer
demo.step.arena.note: Back on the story field: the rule engine, the ML model and the satellite observation, side by side with zones and the NISAR snapshot.
demo.step.close.title: Not a prediction. A rehearsal.
demo.step.close.note: Every recommendation here supports a farmer's judgment; it never replaces it.
